description:
We're a group of passionate students from 2 of the best Ukrainian universities gathered here to try our skills on the challenges provided by NASA and see what we can build in 48 hours. We're passionate about Space, Software, Exploring the Universe, Solving Problems and pushing the boundaries of what we can do. We have a sense of humour. Our Team spirit of Kyiv Polytechnic Institute Polyana is unmatched!
